documents.title: Leadership workshop registration
documents.text:
To: All Department Heads
From: Sylvia Marsh, Training Coordinator
Date: March 4

Dear department heads,
Registration is now open for the two-day Leadership Essentials workshop, which will be held at the Lakeside Conference Center on April 16 and 17. The workshop is led by consultant Dr. Omar Haddad and covers delegation, conflict resolution, and performance feedback. Each department may send up to three participants. The registration fee of $450 per person will be paid by the company, but travel and hotel costs are not covered for staff based outside the city. Please submit names to me by March 22. Because space is limited to 60 people overall, places will be allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.

questions.explanation: Registration is open for the Leadership Essentials workshop.

questions.explanation: The e-mail says each department may send up to three participants.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about late registrations?
choices: They might not receive a place
They will join a repeat workshop
questions.explanation: Places are limited to 60 and allocated first come, first served.

documents.title: Coastal Air Adds Direct Flights to Lisbon
documents.text: PORTLAND (May 7) - Coastal Air announced on Tuesday that it will launch direct flights between Portland and Lisbon starting October 1. [A] The service will operate four days a week using a 180-seat aircraft and is expected to cut travel time by about three hours compared with current connecting itineraries. [B] Introductory round-trip fares will start at $549 for tickets booked before July 31. [C] Tourism officials in Portland welcomed the news, saying the route should bring more European visitors to the region, while local businesses hope for increased cargo opportunities. [D] Coastal Air currently serves 24 cities in North America and plans to add two more European destinations next year.

questions.prompt: What is reported in the article?
choices: A cut in prices on all routes
The purchase of a new airport
questions.explanation: Coastal Air will start direct Portland to Lisbon flights.

questions.prompt: How often will the flights operate?
questions.explanation: The service will operate four days a week.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about current trips from Portland to Lisbon?
choices: They are operated by Coastal Air
questions.explanation: The new flight will cut time compared with connecting itineraries.

questions.prompt: In which position marked [A], [B], [C] or [D] does the following sentence best belong? "Fares will rise after that date."
questions.explanation: 'That date' refers to July 31, mentioned in the sentence about introductory fares just before [C].

documents.title: Notice to residents
documents.text:
Willow Court Apartments
June 10

Dear Residents,
I am writing to inform you of changes that will take effect on September 1. After five years without an increase, rents will rise by 4 percent to cover higher maintenance and insurance costs. For a typical one-bedroom unit, this means an increase of $52 per month. Leases renewed before July 31 will be exempt from the increase for the first six months. In addition, we will repaint the hallways in August and replace the laundry machines in the basement in October; some inconvenience may occur during this work. If you have questions, please visit the management office, open weekdays from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m.
Sincerely,
Brenda Hollis
Property Manager

questions.prompt: Why did Brenda Hollis write the letter?
choices: To invite residents to a meeting
To announce the sale of the building
To inform residents of a rent increase
questions.explanation: Rents will rise by 4 percent on September 1.

questions.prompt: What is the current monthly rent of a typical one-bedroom unit?
questions.explanation: $52 is 4 percent of $1,300.

questions.prompt: What can residents do to delay the increase?
questions.explanation: Leases renewed before July 31 are exempt for six months.

questions.prompt: What will happen in August?
choices: The laundry machines will be replaced
questions.explanation: The hallways will be repainted in August.

documents.title: Helios Solar Opens Factory in Brookfield
documents.text: BROOKFIELD (June 12) - Helios Solar, a manufacturer of rooftop solar panels, opened a new factory in Brookfield on Monday, bringing production closer to its customers in the Midwest. The 200,000-square-foot facility will produce 500,000 panels per year and employ 300 people by the end of next year. "Our previous plant couldn't keep up with orders," said operations director Marcus Ellery. The company will hire for production, quality control, and logistics roles, with many positions open to entry-level applicants who will receive on-the-job training. A job fair will be held at the plant on June 29 from 10 a.m. to 3 p.m.

documents.title: Quality Control Technician: Helios Solar
documents.text: Helios Solar is looking for Quality Control Technicians for its new Brookfield factory. Responsibilities: inspect panels for defects, record test results, and report problems to production supervisors. Requirements: high school diploma; one year of manufacturing experience preferred; ability to lift 20 kg. Shift: Monday to Friday, 6 a.m. to 2 p.m., with occasional overtime. Pay: $21 to $25 per hour. Benefits include health insurance, a 401(k) plan, and a tuition assistance program. Apply online at heliossolar.example/careers or in person at the job fair on June 29.

questions.prompt: Why did Helios Solar open the new factory?
choices: To meet demand and serve customers nearby
questions.explanation: The old plant could not keep up with orders, and the new one is closer to customers.

questions.prompt: Where can applicants apply in person?
choices: At the job fair on June 29
questions.explanation: The ad and the article both mention the June 29 job fair at the plant.

questions.explanation: One year of experience is only preferred, and the article mentions entry-level hiring.

questions.explanation: The article says it will employ 300 people.

questions.explanation: Occasional overtime means overtime that happens now and then.

documents.title: Annual company retreat
documents.text:
TO: All staff
FROM: Events Committee
DATE: September 3
SUBJECT: Annual company retreat

This year's retreat will take place on Friday, October 18, at Pinecrest Lodge, a 90-minute bus ride from the office. Buses will leave at 8 a.m. from the main parking lot and return by 7 p.m. The day will feature team-building activities, a catered lunch, and a short presentation by CEO Marina Costa on next year's goals. Employees may choose one of three afternoon activities: hiking, kayaking, or a pottery workshop. Please complete the attached preference form by September 13. Places for kayaking are limited to 25.
